SELECT A.* ,SUBSTR(SUBSTR(BYR_EMAIL,1,INSTR(BYR_EMAIL,'@')-1),1,1)||LPAD('*',LENGTH(SUBSTR(BYR_EMAIL,1,INSTR(BYR_EMAIL,'@')-1))-1,'*') ||'@'|| SUBSTR(BYR_EMAIL,INSTR(BYR_EMAIL,'@')+1) AS BYR_EMAIL_MASK FROM ( SELECT /*selectBuyerWmGrClosingArSummaryList*/ K.TAX_BILL_NO , MAX(K.AR_CLOSE_MONTH) AS AR_CLOSE_MONTH , MAX(K.ISSUE_DATE) AS ISSUE_DATE , SUM(K.SUPP_PRICE) AS AMT , SUM(K.TAX_PRICE) AS TAX_AMT , SUM(K.AMT) AS TOTAL_AMT , DECODE(MAX(K.TAX_TYPE), '11','과세', '12','영세', '13','면세', '16','영수', '17','수정영수', MAX(K.TAX_TYPE)) AS TAX_TYPE_NM , MAX(K.E_TAX_BILL_FLAG) AS E_TAX_BILL_FLAG , MAX(K.CONFIRM_FLAG) AS CONFIRM_FLAG , K.BUYER_CODE , MAX(K.IRS_NO) AS IRS_NO ,DECODE(MAX(K.IRS_NO),(SELECT CM.IRS_NO FROM ICOMCMPY CM WHERE CM.COM_CODE = #{st_com_code}),'Y','N') AS AR_TYPE --이걸로 비교해서 , (SELECT STATUS.NTS_SEND_STATUS FROM XXSB_DTI_MAIN MAIN, XXSB_DTI_STATUS STATUS WHERE MAIN.SEQ_ID = K.TAX_BILL_NO AND MAIN.CONVERSATION_ID = STATUS.CONVERSATION_ID AND STATUS.NTS_SEND_STATUS = '7' AND MAIN.STATUS <> 'D' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS NTS_SEND_STATUS , DECODE((SELECT STATUS.NTS_SEND_STATUS FROM XXSB_DTI_MAIN MAIN, XXSB_DTI_STATUS STATUS WHERE MAIN.SEQ_ID = K.TAX_BILL_NO AND MAIN.CONVERSATION_ID = STATUS.CONVERSATION_ID AND STATUS.NTS_SEND_STATUS = '7' AND MAIN.STATUS <> 'D' AND ROWNUM = 1), '7', '전송', '미전송') AS NTS_SEND_STATUS_NM ,MAX(XX.BYR_EMAIL) AS BYR_EMAIL
FROM KEPTARDT K , XXSB_DTI_MAIN XX WHERE K.BUYER_CODE = #{st_com_code} AND K.AR_CLOSE_MONTH = #{st_close_month} AND K.STATUS <> 'D' AND K.AR_TYPE = '01' AND K.TAX_BILL_NO = XX.SEQ_ID
AND XX.BYR_EMAIL = #{st_email}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM XXSB_DTI_MAIN MAIN, XXSB_DTI_STATUS STATUS WHERE MAIN.SEQ_ID = K.TAX_BILL_NO AND MAIN.CONVERSATION_ID = STATUS.CONVERSATION_ID AND STATUS.NTS_SEND_STATUS = '7' AND MAIN.STATUS <> 'D' )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM XXSB_DTI_MAIN MAIN, XXSB_DTI_STATUS STATUS WHERE MAIN.SEQ_ID = K.TAX_BILL_NO AND MAIN.CONVERSATION_ID = STATUS.CONVERSATION_ID AND STATUS.NTS_SEND_STATUS = '7' AND MAIN.STATUS <> 'D' )
GROUP BY K.TAX_BILL_NO,K.BUYER_CODE ORDER BY K.TAX_BILL_NO )A

SELECT /*selectBuyerWmGrClosingArDetailList*/ GR.PO_NO , TRIM(GR.REF_PR_NO) AS REF_PR_NO , (SELECT PH.PO_CREATE_DATE FROM ICOMPOHD PH WHERE PH.PO_NO = GR.PO_NO AND PH.BUYER = GR.BUYER AND PH.STATUS <> 'D' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS PO_CREATE_DATE , GR.GR_DATE , TRIM(GR.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , GR.DESCRIPTION , GR.SPECIFICATION , GR.ITEM_QTY AS GR_ITEM_QTY , GR.UNIT_PRICE , GR.ITEM_AMT FROM ICOMGRDT GR WHERE GR.AR_TAX_BILL_NO = #{st_tax_bill_no} AND GR.BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND GR.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY GR.PO_NO, GR.GR_DATE

SELECT /*selectBuyerWmGrClosingArHeaderInfo*/ K.TAX_BILL_NO AS AR_NO , NVL(K.GR_CREATOR_NAME, (SELECT L.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR L WHERE L.USER_ID = K.ADD_USER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1)) AS KEP_MANAGER_NAME , NVL(K.GR_CREATOR_EMAIL, (SELECT L.PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR L WHERE L.USER_ID = K.ADD_USER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1)) AS KEP_MANAGER_TEL FROM KEPTARDT K WHERE K.TAX_BILL_NO = #{st_tax_bill_no} AND K.STATUS <> 'D'
